requirements.quote:
Resetting a stream without the involvement of the application
   protocol could cause the application protocol to enter an
   unrecoverable state.  RESET_STREAM MUST only be instigated by the
   application protocol that uses QUIC.
requirements.required_behavior: The RESET_STREAM must be instigated by the application protocol that uses QUIC.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: A component other than the application protocol that uses QUIC must not instigate RESET_STREAM.
requirements.why_checkable: The implementation can be inspected or instrumented to verify that every RESET_STREAM initiation originates from the application protocol.

requirements.quote:
The semantics of the application error code carried in RESET_STREAM
   are defined by the application protocol.  Only the application
   protocol is able to cause a stream to be terminated.  A local
   instance of the application protocol uses a direct API call, and a
   remote instance uses the STOP_SENDING frame, which triggers an
   automatic RESET_STREAM.
requirements.condition: When processing an application error code carried in RESET_STREAM.
requirements.required_behavior: The semantics of the error code must be determined by the application protocol.
requirements.why_checkable: Error-code interpretation can be checked against the semantics defined by the selected application protocol.

requirements.quote:
The semantics of the application error code carried in RESET_STREAM
   are defined by the application protocol.  Only the application
   protocol is able to cause a stream to be terminated.  A local
   instance of the application protocol uses a direct API call, and a
   remote instance uses the STOP_SENDING frame, which triggers an
   automatic RESET_STREAM.
requirements.condition: When causing a stream to be terminated.
requirements.required_behavior: Only the application protocol is permitted to cause the stream termination.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: A component other than the application protocol must not cause a stream to be terminated.
requirements.why_checkable: Termination call paths and event sources can be inspected to verify that authority is restricted to the application protocol.

requirements.quote:
The semantics of the application error code carried in RESET_STREAM
   are defined by the application protocol.  Only the application
   protocol is able to cause a stream to be terminated.  A local
   instance of the application protocol uses a direct API call, and a
   remote instance uses the STOP_SENDING frame, which triggers an
   automatic RESET_STREAM.
requirements.condition: When a local application-protocol instance causes a stream to be terminated.
requirements.required_behavior: The local application-protocol instance uses a direct API call.
requirements.why_checkable: A focused test can verify that locally initiated stream termination enters QUIC through the direct API path.

requirements.quote:
The semantics of the application error code carried in RESET_STREAM
   are defined by the application protocol.  Only the application
   protocol is able to cause a stream to be terminated.  A local
   instance of the application protocol uses a direct API call, and a
   remote instance uses the STOP_SENDING frame, which triggers an
   automatic RESET_STREAM.
requirements.condition: When a STOP_SENDING frame is received from a remote application-protocol instance.
requirements.required_behavior: Receipt of STOP_SENDING triggers an automatic RESET_STREAM.
requirements.why_checkable: A runtime test can inject STOP_SENDING and verify that the endpoint automatically generates RESET_STREAM.

requirements.quote:
Application protocols SHOULD define rules for handling streams that
   are prematurely canceled by either endpoint.
requirements.condition: When streams can be prematurely canceled by either endpoint.
requirements.required_behavior: The application protocol should define rules for handling those prematurely canceled streams.
requirements.why_checkable: The application protocol specification or implementation policy can be inspected for defined handling rules covering cancellation by either endpoint.
